## Code Review

This pull request introduces API endpoints, route manifests, schemas, and UI components to support allowlisted background "Pulse & Workers" actions, such as diagnostics, logs, and systemic fixes. Feedback highlights several critical issues: a prototype pollution vulnerability when looking up user-controlled actions, incomplete multi-line PEM key redaction due to line-by-line processing, a potential double-invocation of the process finish callback, and a lack of error handling in the frontend action dispatcher.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a helper function `is_blank_output` to check if a string is empty or contains only whitespace, and updates the threshold check to use this function when verifying SARIF output. Corresponding tests have been added to validate this behavior. The review feedback suggests using parameter expansion `${1:-}` in the new function to prevent unbound variable errors under `set -u` when no arguments are passed.

## Code Review

This pull request adds explicit ARIA roles (`role="columnheader"` and `role="cell"`) to the table headers and cells in `PulseWorkersSurface.tsx` and updates the corresponding component tests. The reviewer points out that to maintain a valid ARIA tree structure (especially if CSS overrides default table display properties), you should also explicitly define `role="table"`, `role="rowgroup"`, and `role="row"` on the parent elements, and update the test assertions accordingly.
